derivation: or (by permutation) סוּט; a primitive root;
def: to detrude, i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry)

occurrences.text: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
